Compare keeps the chart on a shared time axis with rank labels (C03); route details stay in place under the chart (C04); Home keeps From and To (C01): the requirements stand until the user revises them

Map behaviours from the boards are not built: stop pins with their next departure and the 5-minute ring (Home), every option drawn at once (Choose), the side-of-road pin (Step), a stop's lines fanning out (Stop), the wide-screen panel. Departure items also lack operator and mode (API-C3)
Chips, the search field, status tags and the segmented control stay pill-shaped (the boards draw 6-8 px corners); radius-pill also shapes round icon buttons
Basemap is OpenFreeMap recoloured, not a purpose-made style
